doc.title: Chazz Frichtel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 13, 2016

title: Festivals and the right move at the right time
summary: Jazz festivals and overseas dates with Mangione, and his decision to grow beyond McDonald's band.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Yeah. And opportunities to play in places that I hadn’t had with some of the other acts. Like we got to play the Clifford Brown Jazz Fest in Delaware, the Newport Jazz Fest, more of the jazz-oriented festivals. The Blue Notes in Italy and New York. And it was a different thing. And it was the right thing for me at the right time. So I didn’t leave Mike’s band to exclusively go with Chuck but I had been there a long time and I knew if I wanted to grow I should go do this. And it was wonderful.
